description_short.value: State-controlled Ghanaian universal bank offering corporate and retail banking, with an emphasis on agriculture.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Agricultural Development Bank PLC 2024 Annual Report (report of the directors, nature of business, p. 11)

description_full.value: Agricultural Development Bank PLC (ADB) holds a universal banking licence in Ghana. Its principal activities are corporate and retail banking, and it aims to serve local and international clients with an emphasis on agriculture. It had 89 branches and agencies at the end of 2024. The bank has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since December 2016. The Government of Ghana holds about 84% of its shares and Financial Investment Trust about 13%. After losses in 2022 and 2023 left its equity negative, ADB was recapitalised through a GHS 1.5 billion rights issue in 2024 and a further GHS 850 million deposit for shares in 2025, and returned to profit.
